function.name: LOAD_PNG
function.abstract: It recovers of disk a PNG graph

description.p: This function recovers a PNG graph from disk. The PNG is a powerful graph format that supports a high compression without loss of data and a lot of other options.

Among other things, a PNG graph supports different levels of transparency per pixel. However, Fenix only accepts two levels (a pixel is transparent, or it is not). This function recovers like transparent those pixels that have 50% or more of transparency in the PNG, and like opaque the rest.

LOAD_PNG returns an entire number that identifies to PNG graph. It is possible to use then this value with any function that allows a graph like parameter, indicating the code 0 of library, or assing the numbert to variable .

function.note: It is only possible to visualize graphs of 16 bits if the current graph mode is of 16 bits. But it is possible to visualize graphs of 8 bits in mode of 16 bits.

There is only an active palette of colours in all time. Use only graphs of 8 bits that use the same palette of colours. Fenix will use automatically the palette of colours of the first graph recovered of disk and will ingore other palettes. Even in mode of 16 bits exists a palette of colours (but in these mode the palette only affects to graphs of 16 bits).
